what: set-account-mode is not durable: scripts/ops/set_account_mode.sh edits config/accounts.yaml `mode:` in the VM working tree only (no commit to main), and ict-git-sync (deploy/ict-git-sync.timer, every 5 min) runs scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh which does `git reset --hard origin/main` (line 117) — the YAML edit is reverted within ~5 min and the runtime keeps the flipped mode only until the next trader restart, after which it silently returns to origin/main's mode. An operator emergency flip to dry_run silently reverts to live. Finding AUD-20260927-CA-A12-set-account-mode-not-durable (docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27/CA-A12.findings.jsonl).
